headlines.title: Visa and Lianlian DigiTech Complete First Live B2B Agentic Commerce Transaction
headlines.line: Visa and Lianlian DigiTech have completed the first live B2B transaction in the Asia Pacific region using a tokenized payment credential specifically for an authorized AI agent.

headlines.title: Visa and Alipay+ Announce Scan to Pay Interoperability in Asia Pacific
headlines.line: Visa and Ant International's Alipay+ have launched a collaboration to enable cross-border 'Scan to Pay' functionality across the Asia Pacific region.

headlines.title: Visa Expands 'Agentic Ready' Program to Acceptance Ecosystem
headlines.line: Visa has expanded its 'Agentic Ready' program to include the acceptance ecosystem, allowing more partners to test AI-initiated payment experiences.

headlines.title: Triple-A Collaborates with Visa to Support Stablecoin Prefunding for Visa Direct
headlines.line: Visa has partnered with Triple-A to enable stablecoin-based prefunding for Visa Direct clients in the Asia Pacific region.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs Raises 2027 Global AI Project Financing Forecast to $545 Billion
headlines.line: Goldman Sachs' credit strategy team increased its 2027 global AI project financing forecast by over 80% to $545 billion, citing significant growth in data center and computing power requirements.

headlines.title: NVIDIA Faces SEC Investigation and Delays Quarterly 10-Q Filing
headlines.line: Following the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang, NVIDIA is under SEC investigation and has delayed its quarterly 10-Q filing.

headlines.title: Apple Services Experience Outage Following Internal Update
headlines.line: Apple experienced a widespread service outage on November 18, 2026, impacting the App Store, iCloud, and internal employee systems due to an internal update.

headlines.title: Stifel Downgrades Insulet to Hold
headlines.line: Stifel has downgraded Insulet Corporation to a Hold rating with a price target of $165.

headlines.title: Stifel Downgrades Bridger Aerospace Group to Hold
headlines.line: Stifel has downgraded Bridger Aerospace Group to a Hold rating with a price target of $0.25.

headlines.title: NVIDIA Co-Founder Jensen Huang Retains Director Nomination Rights
headlines.line: NVIDIA co-founder Jensen Huang retains the right to nominate two directors to the company's board.

headlines.title: Workday Enhances EU Sovereign Cloud with New Governance Safeguards
headlines.line: Workday is establishing a dedicated EU-based operating company to provide increased governance and operational control for its EU Sovereign Cloud service.

headlines.title: Workday Introduces 'Workday GO for Financials'
headlines.line: Workday has launched 'Workday GO for Financials,' a new offering designed to provide growing companies with simplified setup and transparent pricing for financial management software.

headlines.title: Workday Expands Payroll Coverage to Seven New Markets
headlines.line: Workday is expanding its native payroll capabilities to seven additional countries and increasing investment in its French payroll operations.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo & Company Securities Admitted to UK Official List
headlines.line: The UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) admitted bonds issued by Wells Fargo & Company to the Official List on November 18, 2026.

headlines.title: South Korean Regulator Orders Apple to Designate Legal Representatives
headlines.line: South Korean regulators have ordered Apple and several other major technology companies to appoint local legal representatives by January following a rise in customer complaints.

summary:
**Market Summary, 2026-11-18** (data as of 13:33 UTC; moves are for the 2026-11-17 session)

U.S. equity ETFs closed lower on November 17. SPY fell 1.01%, DIA 1.62%, QQQ 0.73% and IWM 1.43%. Financials (XLF, -1.91%) led sector declines, followed by utilities (-1.59%) and health care (-1.41%). Energy (XLE, -0.52%) fell least. VIXY rose 7.41%, and gold (GLD) slipped 0.13%. Pre-market indications were mixed, with SPY up 0.18% and QQQ up 0.59%.

Several thinly traded stocks showed large pre-market moves, including BRBR (+16.4%) and ARDT (-20.1%), but low volume limits their reliability.

Retail sales rose 0.2% against a 0.1% consensus, and core retail sales rose 0.6% against 0.4%. Industrial production fell 0.4% against an expected 0.0%. The NAHB Housing Market Index came in at 25, below the 29 consensus.

Headlines included reports of an SEC investigation and a delayed 10-Q filing at NVIDIA, Goldman Sachs raising its 2027 AI project financing forecast to $545 billion, and several Visa payments announcements.
